name: Talking Tom & Friends
s: Talking Tom and Friends is an animated series where you meet and follow your favorite Talking characters: Tom, Ben, Angela, Ginger and Hank, on their adventures.

paragraphs.text: Talking Tom & Friends (previously Talking Tom and Friends) is a children's animated web and comedy television series by Slovenian company Outfit7, based on the media franchise of the same name. Its premiere release was on 23 December 2014 on YouTube, with the final episode being released on 24 December 2021. The first three seasons of the show were animated and co-produced by the Austrian company ARX Anima, while seasons 4 and 5 were animated and co-produced by the Spanish animation studio People Moving Pixels.

The show is rated three stars out of five by Common Sense Media, which says that "Talking Tom & Friends centers on the animated stars of a popular app series, so kids who know and love them will want to watch their TV antics. On the whole, the content is fine for kids, and there's plenty of silliness (and some body noises and humor) to keep them entertained. That's the show's main intent, so don't expect many teaching moments. The characters argue and get on each other's nerves at times, and some squabbles get physical with tussles and wrestling, but there are no injuries."
The show is available on YouTube, where the show's official channel has 16.2 million subscribers and 7.1 billion views as of May 2026.
